basic_details.scholarship_name: UC San Diego (UCSD) CSE Graduate Fellowship & Doctoral Assistantship Package
basic_details.offering_entity: University of California San Diego (Department of Computer Science and Engineering & Jacobs School of Engineering)
basic_details.host_institutions_covered: University of California San Diego Main Campus (La Jolla, California, USA)
degree_levels: Doctor of Philosophy (PhD in Computer Science)
Doctor of Philosophy (PhD in Computer Engineering)
basic_details.major_restrictions: Restricted to PhD students in Computer Science and Computer Engineering: Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Systems & Networking, Security & Cryptography, Programming Languages, Bioinformatics, Robotics, and Theory of Computation.
basic_details.number_of_awards_total: 100% of admitted PhD students receive guaranteed multi-year full financial support (~90 to 110 admitted doctoral students annually)
basic_details.number_of_awards_pakistan: Open global merit competition; typically 3 to 7 high-achieving Pakistani graduates admitted per academic year
basic_details.duration_of_scholarship: Guaranteed 5-year full doctoral funding package, subject to maintaining satisfactory academic and research progress

nationality_requirements: Open to international and domestic applicants holding a valid passport
eligibility_requirements.academic_qualifications: A recognized 4-year Bachelor's degree (BS/BE) or Master's degree (MS) in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Mathematics, or closely related discipline from an HEC-recognized university with minimum cumulative GPA of 3.50 / 4.00 (competitive admits typically have 3.80+ / 4.00 or top 2% of class).
eligibility_requirements.grading_conversion_notes: UCSD requires a minimum cumulative GPA of 3.0 / 4.0 for Graduate Division admission, but CSE doctoral cutoff is de facto 3.50+ due to intense competition.
eligibility_requirements.subject_background_prerequisites: Substantial coursework in algorithms, computer systems, operating systems, linear algebra, discrete mathematics, and programming abstractions.
eligibility_requirements.current_education_status: Graduating seniors in their final year of BS or MS can apply; official degree completion required prior to Fall registration.
eligibility_requirements.work_experience_notes: Formal industry experience is secondary to demonstrated research capability (first-author papers, research prototypes, open-source software, high-impact GitHub repos).
eligibility_requirements.language_notes: TOEFL iBT min 85 (CSE recommended 100+; speaking score 23+ required for Teaching Assistantships) or IELTS Academic min 7.0 (speaking band 7.0+ for TA eligibility). Duolingo and MOI certificates not accepted for international graduate admissions.
eligibility_requirements.other_language_requirements: None; all campus instruction and research conducted in English.
eligibility_requirements.gender_specific_requirements: None; female and underrepresented researchers in computing strongly encouraged.
eligibility_requirements.special_eligibility_categories: Exceptional candidates nominated for Jacobs School of Engineering Dean's Fellowships and CSE Departmental Merit Fellowships.
eligibility_requirements.previous_scholarship_restrictions: Holders of external prestigious fellowships (e.g., Fulbright, Google PhD Fellowship) receive institutional stipend top-ups.

tuition_fee.details: Full California resident and Non-Resident Supplemental Tuition (NRST) remission fully covered (~USD 34,000 to USD 36,000 / year value).

admission_application_fee.details: UCSD international graduate application fee of USD 155 paid online via credit card. (Fee waivers rarely granted to international applicants).

accommodation.details: Subsidized graduate student housing at UCSD (Mesa, One Miramar, Central Mesa, Nuevo West, Nuevo East) guaranteed for incoming PhD students at below-market rates (~USD 850 to 1,200/month for private bedroom in shared graduate apartment).
accommodation.amount: Paid from monthly stipend (~USD 950 / month; ~PKR 266,000 / mo)

monthly_stipend.details: Guaranteed 5-year annual stipend of USD 38,000 to USD 44,000 / year (~USD 3,166 to 3,666 / month; ~PKR 885,000 to 1,025,000 / month) provided via Graduate Student Researcher (GSR) appointments, Teaching Assistantships (TA), and department fellowships.

airfare.details: International travel between Pakistan and San Diego International Airport (SAN) / Los Angeles International Airport (LAX) is self-funded.

visa_fee.details: US F-1 student visa fee (USD 185) and SEVIS I-901 fee (USD 350) paid directly to US government.

health_insurance.details: UC Student Health Insurance Plan (UC SHIP) fully paid by the department, providing medical, dental, vision, and mental health coverage (~USD 4,800 / year value).

food_allowance.details: Food and living subsistence covered comfortably by the monthly GSR/TA stipend.

books_and_materials_allowance.details: Research workstations, high-end compute servers, access to San Diego Supercomputer Center (SDSC) and Nautilus cluster provided by CSE labs.

research_funding_conference_grant.details: Research travel grants (USD 1,500 to 3,000 per conference) provided by advising professors and UCSD Graduate Student Association for papers accepted at top conferences (NeurIPS, ICML, CVPR, OSDI, SOSP, SIGCOMM).

travel_transit_allowance.details: UCSD Triton U-Pass provides unlimited free transit across San Diego Metropolitan Transit System (MTS) trolley and bus lines.

university_and_program_options.single_or_multiple_universities: Single world-leading public research university: University of California San Diego (La Jolla, CA, USA)
participating_institutions: UC San Diego - Department of Computer Science and Engineering (CSE)
UC San Diego - Jacobs School of Engineering
university_and_program_options.university_rankings_scope: Top 15 global computer science university (US News CS #11, CSRankings #4, THE World #34); world leader in systems, bioinformatics, AI, and computer vision.

PhD in Computer Science: Computer Vision & Robotics

university_and_program_options.admission_requirements_summary: 4-year BS or MS in CS/CE/STEM with 3.5+ GPA, 3 letters of recommendation, statement of purpose, CV, and TOEFL 85+ (100+ recommended) or IELTS 7.0+. GRE is not required.
university_and_program_options.easiest_hardest_institutions_guidance: Machine learning, computer vision, and robotics have largest application pools; computer systems, security, programming languages, and theory present slightly higher admission probability for deeply qualified candidates.
university_and_program_options.strategic_program_match_advice: Explicitly identify 3-5 UCSD CSE faculty members in the application portal whose recent research directly aligns with your background, and cite their specific papers in your statement of purpose.

application_process_roadmap.account_creation_instructions: Register on the UCSD GradApply portal, select Department of Computer Science and Engineering, select Doctor of Philosophy, choose primary research subfields, and upload required materials.
step_by_step_workflow: Step 1 (September - November): Research UCSD CSE faculty labs and identify 3-5 potential doctoral advisors.
Step 2 (October - December): Complete online profile on the UCSD GradApply portal.
Step 3 (November - December): Upload statement of purpose, CV/resume, unofficial transcripts, and register 3 academic recommenders.
Step 4 (By 15 December): Submit application and pay USD 155 application fee.
Step 5 (January - February): Faculty sub-committees review applications and conduct technical video interviews.
Step 6 (February - March): Department issues official PhD admission offer letters with 5-year guaranteed funding package.
Step 7 (By 15 April): Submit formal acceptance of admission offer.
Step 8 (May - July): Receive Form I-20 from UCSD International Students & Programs Office and apply for US F-1 visa.
application_process_roadmap.university_vs_scholarship_routing: Integrated automatic funding: 100% of admitted PhD students are automatically awarded 5-year full funding packages comprising GSR/TA positions and fellowships.
application_process_roadmap.recommendation_letters_submission_method: Three confidential recommendation letters uploaded electronically by referees via the GradApply portal.
application_process_roadmap.personal_statement_prompts: Statement of Purpose: 2-page essay discussing research experience, specific research interests, and faculty alignment at UCSD.
application_process_roadmap.study_plan_research_proposal_requirement: Integrated into statement of purpose; focus on concrete research problems, past methodological contributions, and prospective research directions.
application_process_roadmap.cv_format_requirements: Academic CV detailing publications, open-source code repositories (GitHub), research prototypes, and technical coursework.
application_process_roadmap.interview_format_details: 1-2 video interviews (30-60 minutes via Zoom) conducted by prospective faculty advisors to assess technical depth, mathematical problem solving, and research motivation.
application_process_roadmap.standardized_tests: TOEFL iBT (85+ minimum; 100+ recommended) or IELTS Academic (7.0+). GRE is permanently NOT required.
application_process_roadmap.attestation_requirements: Unofficial scanned transcripts submitted with application; official degree certificates required upon accepting offer.
application_process_roadmap.translation_requirements: Certified English translation required for any documents not in English.
application_process_roadmap.final_submission_method: 100% digital submission via the UCSD GradApply portal.

required_documents_checklist.specification: PDF scans of official transcripts from all post-secondary institutions attended with grading scale explanation.
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Pakistani applicants submit 4-year BS transcripts; HEC attestation not required for initial review, but verified final degree required upon enrollment.

required_documents_checklist.specification: Concise 2-page essay articulating research experience, specific research problems you wish to investigate, and why UCSD CSE faculty are an ideal fit.
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Avoid generic childhood narratives; focus 80%+ on concrete technical projects, research methodology, and proposed directions.

required_documents_checklist.specification: 3 letters of recommendation from faculty members or research directors who have directly supervised your research or advanced coursework.
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Letters must be submitted via university domain emails (.edu.pk); strong research letters from professors with international standing carry highest weight.

required_documents_checklist.specification: Detailed CV listing publications, preprints (arXiv), open-source code repositories (GitHub), academic honors, and coursework.
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Clearly link papers, open-source repositories, and competitive programming achievements.

required_documents_checklist.specification: Official TOEFL iBT (code 4836) or IELTS Academic score report taken within past 2 years.
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Aim for TOEFL speaking 26+ or IELTS speaking 7.5+ to qualify immediately for Teaching Assistantships without campus oral exams.

required_documents_checklist.specification: Copies of published or submitted workshop/conference/journal papers demonstrating research caliber.
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Strongly recommended; uploading first-author or co-authored papers dramatically elevates an applicant's profile.

important_dates_timeline.annual_cycle_notes: Admissions offered exclusively for Fall quarter. No spring/winter doctoral admissions.

selection_process_and_weights.academic_weight: 25% (rigor of undergraduate program, GPA, mathematics and systems course grades)
selection_process_and_weights.research_experience_weight: 40% (published papers, research portfolio, originality of SOP, GitHub projects)
selection_process_and_weights.personal_statement_weight: 10% (clarity of research vision and articulation of technical goals)
selection_process_and_weights.recommendations_weight: 10% (detailed assessment from research advisors assessing independent research capability)
selection_process_and_weights.interview_weight: 5% (alignment with faculty research grants and technical fluency during interview)
selection_process_and_weights.selection_panel_composition: CSE Graduate Admissions Committee, area faculty sub-committees (AI, Systems, Theory), and individual faculty lab PIs.
selection_process_and_weights.evaluation_methodology: Holistic faculty-driven evaluation: Initial screening by CSE Admissions Committee followed by faculty sub-committee review in candidate's chosen research area. Faculty advisors personally interview and champion candidates for funding.

competitiveness_profile.total_scholarships_awarded: ~90 to 110 funded PhD offers accepted annually
competitiveness_profile.acceptance_rate_global: ~4% to 6% admit rate for CSE doctoral program
competitiveness_profile.acceptance_rate_pakistan: ~3% to 5% among applicants from top Pakistani institutions
competitiveness_profile.typical_academic_and_research_profile: Undergraduate degree in CS/CE from premier university (FAST-NUCES, NUST, LUMS, GIKI), 1-2 research papers at international venues or significant open-source contributions, stellar recommendation letters.
competitiveness_profile.common_backgrounds_of_winners: Graduates of NUST (SEECS), FAST-NUCES, LUMS, GIKI, and UET Lahore.
competitiveness_profile.high_representation_countries: United States, China, India, South Korea, Pakistan, Iran, Canada

fake_websites_and_scams: Commercial overseas education agencies claiming guaranteed admission or funded seats at UCSD. Admissions are strictly merit-based and controlled by faculty.
red_flags_and_warnings.application_fee_warning: Application fee of USD 155 is paid strictly through the official UCSD GradApply portal. Never pay fees via unauthorized third parties.
red_flags_and_warnings.agent_and_intermediary_warnings: UCSD does not partner with recruitment agents. Submissions showing boilerplate agent statements are systematically rejected.
hidden_costs_breakdown: US F-1 Visa and SEVIS I-901 fees: USD 535 (~PKR 150,000).
Flight from Pakistan to San Diego/Los Angeles: ~PKR 350,000 to 500,000.
Initial settling cash and housing deposit: ~USD 1,500 (~PKR 420,000).
misleading_claims_debunked: CLAIM: GRE General Test is required. (FACT: UCSD CSE has permanently eliminated the GRE requirement for graduate admissions).
CLAIM: Direct contact with professors is useless. (FACT: Prospective advisors review applications directly; polite, paper-specific outreach can lead to interview invitations).
official_vs_unofficial_discrepancies: Unofficial sites claim Master's students receive full funding. At UCSD, full multi-year funding packages are guaranteed almost exclusively to PhD students.

scholarship_obligations_and_terms.minimum_gpa_maintenance: Must maintain cumulative GPA of 3.00 / 4.00 or higher in all coursework with no grade below B-.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.attendance_requirements: Full-time physical enrollment (minimum 12 units per quarter) and active engagement in laboratory research.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.academic_progress_monitoring: Annual Spring Evaluation conducted by thesis advisor and CSE graduate committee to verify satisfactory progress.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.work_restrictions_during_study: Graduate Student Researcher and Teaching Assistant appointments are limited to 20 hours per week (50% appointment) during academic quarters to preserve research focus.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.home_country_return_obligation: None. Eligible for standard US F-1 Optional Practical Training (OPT) including 3-year STEM extension and employer-sponsored H-1B / O-1 / EB-2 NIW visas.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.repayment_clawback_conditions: Funding ceased upon withdrawal or academic disqualification; no repayment of previous salary or fee remissions required.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.rules_for_changing_university: Fellowship packages are non-transferable to other universities.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.rules_for_changing_major: Changing doctoral advisors within CSE requires finding a faculty member with grant funding willing to accept the student.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.extension_policy: Guaranteed 5-year funding; 6th year funding is customary if supported by advisor's external research grants.
